findings.expected_vs_actual: Expected: the no-turn test fails if runUntil/runUntilMyTurn stops honouring maxRealMs. Actual: with the real-time bound removed from the helper, the test still passes on Chromium (rejects after 29.7 s via the 600,000 ms fake bound, just under the 30 s test timeout); only WebKit catches it by timing out. The assertion checks only the message prefix, which both bounds produce.
findings.fix: Make the no-turn test prove the real-time bound tripped, e.g. require the rejection within a few seconds of real time or require the reported fake time to be well below maxFakeMs.
